what: PAN-14 'python -m pan frontier like PATH': outside papers nearest to a repository file, measured by citation recovery
model: Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B (document vectors 512 d; paper vectors from title + abstract, same space)
benchmark_rule: every repository file at d6b2eeeca (excluding roles/Pan/) whose chunks mention an arXiv id present in pan.frontier_item (source arxiv); success = any cited id ranked <= k among all 4,702 arXiv items by cosine to the file's document vector. Generated automatically; Pan wrote none of the citations.
reading: Real signal (about 165x the random rate at k=10) but modest: for two files in three the cited paper is not in the top 10. Use as an exploratory pivot, never as a relevance verdict.
caveats: A file that cites a paper may describe it in words that also match the paper (lexical leakage inflates recall).
Only arXiv items fetched by the seed queries are in the corpus (4,702).
